svg.text: Figure 7-2. Control Plane and Data Plane Topology of a Distributed Rate Limiting Platform.

g.text: Zero-downtime rule updates · Dry-run shadow evaluation · Heavy-hitter detection
Data Plane (Hot Path: < 1 ms p99 Overhead Across 3 Availability Zones)
L1 local quota lease -> Stateless gRPC limiter -> Sharded Redis Cluster with atomic Lua GCRA
Solid: Sync admission hot path (1->4, < 1 ms p99)
Dashed: 429 reject (5), xDS rule push & shadow telemetry

svg.text: Separating rule compilation (control plane) from quota evaluation (data plane) keeps hot-path p99 under 1 ms.
On Redis store timeout, the gateway circuit breaker enforces the route policy: fail-open with
local fallback for general traffic, or fail-closed for authentication and billing endpoints.
